decks.notes: The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Daze, the deck aims to control the board and prevent the opponent from developing their own threats. Cards like Ponder and Brainstorm help smooth out draws and find necessary answers. Furthermore, the deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Quantum Riddler to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays paired with disruption tactics like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to control the opponent's hand. The deck includes powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Voice of Victory to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Orcish Bowmasters and Goblin Bombardment for additional removal options. Land disruption with cards like Wasteland and utility lands like Karakas also add to the deck's versatility and ability to stay ahead in the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Aluren combo to quickly win the game by casting creatures for free. It includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Acererak the Archlich to take advantage of the combo, while also running cards like Show and Tell and Omniscience to cheat out powerful creatures. The deck also includes protection spells like Force of Will and Veil of Summer to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. With the right setup, this deck can overwhelm opponents and secure a victory in the Legacy 1 vs 1 format.

The deck focuses on controlling the board early with Cloudpost and Tron Ramp strategies while using powerful spells like Stock Up, Kozilek's Command, and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The One Ring and Ugin, Eye of the Storms provide late-game win conditions, while Force of Will and Force of Negation help protect your key cards. Karn, the Great Creator is used to search for artifacts like Grim Monolith and Thundertrap Trainer for additional mana acceleration and board control. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through powerful spells and mana generation.

The main concept of this Aluren combo deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, while using cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for combo pieces. The deck aims to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Show and Tell and Aluren. Additionally, the deck includes disruption with Force of Will and Veil of Summer to protect the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

This Death & Taxes Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while putting pressure on them with efficient creatures like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Recruiter of the Guard. The deck utilizes cards like Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck gains additional value through flickering creatures like Flickerwisp and Skyclave Apparition. With a mix of disruptive elements and aggressive threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver and overwhelm the opponent in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this Legacy 1 vs 1 Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy while applying pressure with aggressive creatures and tempo plays. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Daze to control the board and protect your threats like Nethergoyf and Bilbo, Thief in the Night, you can outmaneuver your opponent and secure victories through a combination of disruption and aggression. The deck also utilizes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Snuff Out to maintain board control and ensure your creatures can get through to deal damage.

This Dimir Tempo deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Daze, while also utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push and Snuff Out. The deck aims to deploy threats like Nethergoyf and Bilbo, Thief in the Night to pressure the opponent and close out the game quickly. The deck also utilizes disruptive spells like Brainstorm and Wasteland to control the board and maintain tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to be aggressive and controlling, punishing opponents for slow starts and misplays.

The main focus of this Bant Control deck is to utilize powerful control elements such as Quantum Riddler, Leyline Binding, and Force of Will to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect key cards. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Meticulous Archive to maintain card advantage and outvalue opponents. Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Murktide Regent provide additional threats and win conditions. The mana base includes fetchlands to ensure color consistency and access to multiple colors for versatile plays. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and outgrind opponents with a combination of disruption, card advantage, and threats.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and disrupting their strategies through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells. It aims to slow down the game and establish board control before efficiently closing out the game with powerful creatures like Phyrexian Dreadnought. The deck also has a strong card draw engine with Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain its resources and find key pieces. With a mix of control elements and threats, the deck seeks to outmaneuver and outvalue the opponent in the long game.

The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by using efficient spells and creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent while disrupting their strategies. It utilizes cheap counterspells like Daze and Force of Will, along with versatile removal like Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and keep the hand full. The focus is on deploying threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Cori-Steel Cutter early in the game and maintaining board presence while applying pressure to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes land hate in the form of Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's plans and Stoneforge Mystic to tutor up equipment like Swords to Plowshares and Meteor Sword, this deck aims to control the game tempo and gradually wear down the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in longer games. Overall, this deck focuses on a proactive playstyle that punishes the opponent's missteps.

The main concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal, to then cast a high storm count spell such as Tendrils of Agony or Ad Nauseam to win the game. Cards like Infernal Tutor and Burning Wish are used to search for specific combo pieces, while Thoughtseize and Duress help disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Veil of Summer and Gaea's Will to protect against disruption and ensure a successful combo turn.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and disruptive abilities such as Stifle and Wasteland. The deck utilizes Stoneforge Mystic to search for powerful equipment like Batterskull and Pre-War Formalwear to gain further control over the board. Additionally, the deck includes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to generate card advantage and provide additional control options. The deck aims to outvalue and outgrind the opponent while disrupting their game plan.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, and Voice of Victory to put pressure on the opponent. It also utilizes cards like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck has a low mana curve and aims to win the game through a combination of creature damage and burn spells like Swords to Plowshares. The inclusion of cards like Karakas and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd provide additional utility and resilience against opposing strategies.

The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage engines. The deck aims to control the board with efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, protect its own game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, and generate card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The inclusion of Lórien Revealed and Quantum Riddler helps provide additional card selection and filtering, ensuring the deck can consistently find the right answers to any threats.
